answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 9533 Country: Canada Title: What is the proper method of holding a miswaak? Question: What is the proper method of holding a miswaak? Answer ID: 9533 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2226/2037=D/1429) قال في المراقي: والسنۃ في أخذہ أن تجعل خنصر یمینک أسفلہ والبنصر والسبابۃ فوقہ والإبھام أسفل رأسہ، کما رواہ ابن مسعود i.e. the little finger of right hand should be placed under the miswak, the ring finger and index finger over it, while the thumb should be placed over the head of it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
